adapters.name: rtl8812au
adapters._power_comment: §10.5 offset space (qdb = 0.25 dB against the chip's efuse table). Boot at -24 (-6 dB, the Pass 150 seed, what this camera always ran at). The ground menu's Camera > TX Power picks a preset over §11.7 0x0A; with no calibrated curve the preset IS the offset (Pass 214), so -18/-12/-6/-3/0 dB. power_offset_max_qdb 0 keeps every preset at or under the chip table. policy.cmd.persist_tx_power (Pass 215) keeps the chosen preset across reboots; delete /etc/waybeam-link/power.json to boot at -24 again.

streams._fec_comment: §14.1 rlc256, same rates as the fleet vehicles (deploy/vehicle-*.json). With fec none every lost packet killed its frame (2.9% frames_unrecoverable at 1% packet loss, 2026-10-31) and the H.265 refs stayed broken until the next IDR (gopSize 1 s) — visible as stutter. The table's fec_overhead_frac (0.25) budgets this parity (§9.5 Pass 95).

policy._select_comment: Pinned to profile id 1 = MCS2 of the shared MCS1-5 table (hi3536dv100-ground/config/table-mcs1-5.json, id = MCS - 1). The ground menu's Camera > MCS re-pins it over §11.7 0x0C PROFILE (Pass 214); a reboot returns here.
policy._cmd_comment: §15.2 Pass 215: the TX power preset the ground picked is saved to /etc/waybeam-link/power.json and restored at boot; ANNOUNCE advertises it so the ground menu shows the camera's real power.
policy._csa_comment: §11 follow-me channel switch, issued by the ground menu. Only allowlisted targets are accepted. persist_channel (Pass 210) boots onto the last committed channel (/etc/waybeam-link/channel.json); delete it to return to adapters[].channel.

_osd_comment: §11.7 0x0B OSD_STYLE (Pass 212): the ground menu picks a style by index into the name-sorted fonts/*.png catalog (0xFE/0xFF = OSD on/off); the link forks apply_cmd with the style name, @on or @off. waybeam/deploy-gk7205.sh installs both.
